sentences.text: Opposite Party :- State of U.P. and Another Counsel for Applicant :- Satyendra Kumar Singh
Counsel for Opposite Party :- G.A.,Pawan Kumar Tiwari Hon'ble Arun Kumar Singh Deshwal,J.
1. Heard Sri Satyendra Kr. Singh, learned counsel for the applicants, Sri Pawan Kr. Tiwari, learned counsel for opposite party No.2 and Sri P.P. Tiwari, learned A.G.A. for the State.

2. The instant application has been filed to quash the impugned orders dated 4.3.2025 and 5.11.2024 in Case No. 1736 of 2022, arising out of case crime No. 2354 of 2021, u/s 498A, 323, 504,
506, 420 IPC and 3/4 D.P. Act, P.S. Indirapuram, District Ghaziabad.
3. A preliminary objection has been raised by learned counsel for opposite party No.2 that the applicants have earlier filed Criminal Revision No. 611 of 2025 against the order of framing charges.
However, that revision was withdrawn by the revisionists with the liberty to file a fresh revision.
Therefore, the present application is not maintainable as the liberty was granted to the applicants to file a fresh revision.
